snippet.title: KORG Gadget for PlayStation - Make music a fun game-like experience.
snippet.description:
Make music a fun game-like experience.
The next-generation music production studio now on PlayStation®5.

KORG Gadget now enters its next stage with support for PlayStation®5. KORG Gadget for PlayStation uses the cutting-edge Unreal Engine, one of the most powerful game engines available. Gadgets are arranged in a fully immersive 360° environment, newly designed with highly detailed and realistic visuals. Experience the next-generation music production studio with KORG Gadget on PlayStation®5.

More info:
https://www.korg.com/us/products/software/korg_gadget_for_playstation/
